# PR B — Compression sweep (draft PR body)

Title: PR B: Compression sweep — inline wrappers, archive generators, compat shims

## Summary

- Inline thin wrappers when safe and keep subprocess fallbacks.
- Archive generator originals under `Projects/Tooling/generators/_archived_originals/` and add deprecation stubs at original paths.
- Move compatibility shims to `Projects/Tooling/compat` and add `deprecated_` shim APIs.
- Harden `ui_schema_validator` with `_SCHEMA_CACHE`, preloaded resolver `store`, and non-fatal fallback validation.
- Update a set of import sites to use canonical `Prismata.Projects.Tooling.*` paths; additional import updates are in-progress.

## Tests & safety

- Ran `pytest` locally: 29 passed (targeted test run); warnings include `jsonschema.RefResolver` deprecation.
- Ran wrapper tests for ASTalyzer and menu primitive tests; targeted tests passed.

## Checklist (confirm before merge)

- [ ] Finish repo-wide import-site updates to point at `Projects/Tooling/compat` (in-progress).
- [ ] Run full `pytest -q` across repository and resolve any remaining warnings/errors.
- [ ] Validate manifests/CI: ensure workspace manifest overrides are acceptable for CI.
- [ ] Add migration notes for consumers (update import paths; deprecated shims available under `Projects/Tooling/compat`).
- [ ] Squash/fix any review feedback and confirm runtime smoke tests.

## Notes for reviewers

- Archival approach chosen to avoid breaking CI and allow staged migration.
- If you want automation to open the PR, install the GitHub CLI `gh` or create the PR via the web UI using branch `feature/pr-b-compression-sweep` and this body.

Branch: `feature/pr-b-compression-sweep`

Location: `Projects/Tooling/PR_B_draft_PR_body.md`
